name: Covered Straddle
summary: Own 100 shares and sell both an ATM call and an ATM put at the same strike - maximum premium, maximum obligation to double the position.

legs.strike_rule: ATM, same strike as the call, cash-secured

max_profit: (strike - share basis) x 100 + total credits x 100, achieved at or above the strike
max_loss: (share basis + strike - total credits) x 100 - 200 shares of downside

greeks.delta: +100 per unit at entry (100 shares, +50 put, -50 call)

when_to_use: Very high IV Rank (>= 50), strongly range-bound expectation, and complete willingness to own 200 shares. This is an aggressive, capital-hungry structure - FLAGGED as high risk for automation without strict sizing.
entry_rules: 100 shares held AND cash >= strike x 100.
IV Rank >= 50; combined ATM credit >= 4% of spot for a 30-45 DTE cycle.
Total share exposure at the doubled size <= 25% of equity.
Strike = nearest to spot; both legs same strike and expiry; OI >= 500 each (ATM is the most liquid area).
Never on a name with earnings, an FDA date, or any binary event inside the cycle.
management_rules: Close at 25-35% of total credit - do not push an ATM short straddle to 50%, the gamma is too high.
One side will always be ITM. Roll the tested side out (and away) for a credit once its delta exceeds 0.70 in absolute terms; leave the untested side alone.
If the put is threatened, prefer closing the whole unit to doubling the share position.
exit_rules: HARD: at least one leg is nearly always ITM - both short legs must be flattened by 15:30 ET on expiration day, without exception.
Extrinsic guard on both legs: close when extrinsic < 0.05 and |delta| > 0.85.
Ex-dividend guard on the short call (ATM calls go ITM easily).
Unit stop: close everything if the unit loss exceeds 2% of account equity.
assignment_risk: Highest routine assignment probability of any covered structure - an ATM straddle almost guarantees one leg finishes ITM. Put assignment doubles the share position at the strike; call assignment removes the shares. The system must treat this structure as requiring continuous monitoring, not end-of-day checks.
buying_power: Shares plus strike x 100 in cash.
liquidity_needs: ATM strikes, OI >= 500, penny or nickel wide.
common_mistakes: Chasing the fat ATM premium without modeling the 200-share downside; managing at 50% like an OTM strangle; letting an ITM leg run to expiration.
zero_dte_notes: An ATM 0DTE covered straddle is near-certain assignment on one side. Not appropriate.
family: Stock/ETF Shares Combined With Options (covered writes, protective hedges, collars, synthetics, repairs, conversions)
